properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test suites exercising the library's real secp256k1 ECDH: SigningKey.computeSharedSecret (src.ts/crypto/signing-key.ts:97-99) derives the shared secret via secp256k1.getSharedSecret from @noble/curves — a quantum-vulnerable (Shor) key agreement, migration target ML-KEM-768. Matched sites are the describe() titles in src.ts/_tests/test-crypto.ts:105 and lib.commonjs/lib.esm copies; the test vectors (keyA/keyB/shared) drive the shipped implementation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The Web3 Secret Storage keystore's memory-hard KDF, plus the library's exported scrypt wrapper (src.ts/crypto/scrypt.ts). Decrypt reads N/r/p from the keystore JSON and calls scrypt/scryptSync (json-keystore.ts decrypt path; dist/ethers.js:25434-25518); encrypt generates a random 32-byte salt and defaults N=131072 (1<<17), r=8, p=1 (json-keystore.ts:257-270). scrypt is the default KDF for new keystores. Symmetric KDF — not Shor-relevant.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: keccak256 (Keccak-256 with the pre-standard padding) — the Ethereum workhorse hash, exported from src.ts/crypto/keccak.ts via @noble/hashes sha3; used for transaction/block hashing, EIP-55 address checksums, signing digests, the keystore MAC and ABI encoding. 272 sites across dist/lib bundles and test fixtures. 256-bit hash — PQ-reasonable (128-bit collision under Grover).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The library's exported PBKDF2 wrapper (src.ts/crypto/pbkdf2.ts, backed by node:crypto pbkdf2Sync per crypto.ts:3 or @noble/hashes pbkdf2 per crypto-browser.ts:4) and its customers: keystore kdf="pbkdf2" path (count/dkLen/algorithm from keystore JSON — json-keystore.ts; dist/ethers.js:25446-25503), BIP39 mnemonic-to-seed (2048/SHA-512, mnemonic.ts:147), legacy crowdsale decrypt (2000/SHA-256, json-crowdsale.ts:58). The weak-parameter subset is tracked separately as ALG-a861135a.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128-CTR: the keystore cipher (encrypt writes cipher:"aes-128-ctr", decrypt requires it — json-keystore.ts; dist/ethers.js:25392,25566) and the legacy crowdsale seed decrypt (16-byte key from PBKDF2-SHA256 — json-crowdsale.ts:58). AES is Grover-attacked only (128-bit key → 64-bit quantum security; AES-256 would be the PQ-safe choice) but the width is fixed by the keystore format. Mode/width changeable only via format revision.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha256 wrapper (src.ts/crypto/sha2.ts) over @noble/hashes sha256 (crypto-browser.ts:5) / node:crypto createHash (crypto.ts:3); used for BIP32 key fingerprints (ripemd160(sha256(publicKey)) in wallet/hdwallet.ts) and as the HMAC/PBKDF2 compression function in the keystore pbkdf2 path. PQ-fine.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Primary hash/MAC/KDF provider of this library, declared in package.json and bundled into the dist artifacts: supplies sha256/sha512 (crypto-browser.ts:5-6), hmac (crypto-browser.ts:3), pbkdf2 (crypto-browser.ts:4), ripemd160 (ripemd160.ts:1), plus the keccak/SHA-3 behind keccak.ts and the scrypt implementation. Its locked version decides the quality of everything the browser build ships. Changeable here (bump dependency).
